As camadas de som de um plano: The sound layers of a shot
Cinco camadas. Clique em cada uma e veja: Five layers. Click each one and see where it usually comes from.
Vento, rua, rádio ao fundo. Diz onde a c: Wind, street, a radio in the background. It tells where the scene takes place without showing it. It usually comes out well from the generator, together with the image (native sound).
Porta, passos, vapor, a casca do pão est: Door, footsteps, steam, the bread crust crackling. Foley is the effect recorded separately and synced to the image. If the effect has to land on an exact frame, native or recorded in sync.
Diálogo curto sincronizado com a boca: e: Short dialogue synced to the mouth: in Oct/2026 the main generators do it in the same pass. Long narration, which runs across several shots, is recorded or synthesized separately.
A música que só o público ouve. Atravess: The music only the audience hears. It runs across shots, so it goes in at the edit, never shot by shot. Under a line, a score without vocals.
Juntar tudo com hierarquia: a voz domina: Put it all together with a hierarchy: the voice dominates, the music stays underneath, the effect appears at the right moment. Check with headphones at the end.

Na cena \"A primeira fornada\", com a co: In the scene "The first batch", using the sound column of the shot list from course 0.
Áudio nativo virou padrão em 2026 nos pr: Native audio became the standard in 2026 in the main generators (dated examples, Oct/2026: Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.x, Runway Gen-4.5). Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 10 reference audios per generation.
Use o nativo para o que nasce do plano:: Use native for what comes from the shot: ambience, the effect of the action, a short line. Keep separate what crosses shots, what has to sound the same in all of them, and what will change language.
Vento e batidas na porta: nativos. Trilh: Wind and knocks on the door: native. Score and opening narration: separate, in the edit.
o que se ouve diz onde estamos: what you hear tells you where we are
Som diegético existe na cena e o persona: Diegetic sound exists in the scene and the character hears it; non-diegetic sound only the audience hears, like the score. A well-resolved shot has ambience and the effect of the action.
Silêncio também é escolha: cortar a músi: Silence is a choice too: cut the music before the turning point, leave one shot with only the ambience, a breath after the impact. If you can show it, don't narrate it.

A voz domina; a música fica atmosférica,: The voice dominates; the music stays atmospheric, underneath; the effect appears at the moment of the action. The most common mistake is leaving the music at the same volume as the voice.

Planos gerados em dias e ferramentas dif: Shots generated on different days and in different tools arrive with different colors, and raw AI imagery has telltale marks: aggressive contrast, oversaturated color, crushed flat blacks. Color correction matches the shots and gives the film a single look. You leave with the recipe written down, and it works in any editor.

Ajustar contraste, pretos e cor por faix: Adjust contrast, blacks and color by range
Pôr grão e halation só no fim e só onde: Add grain and halation only at the end, and only where they make sense
Suíte de correção de cor escura com pain: A dark color-grading suite with a three-trackball panel, a reference monitor in the background and a strip of film on a light table.
Cinco etapas, nesta ordem. Clique em cad: Five steps, in this order. Click each one.
Comece de imagem plana: contraste baixo,: Start from a flat image: low contrast, no grain, nothing blown out in the highlights or crushed in the shadows. That leaves you information to build the look. Asking the generator for "film grain" decides the finishing too early.
Antes do look, deixe os planos vizinhos: Before the look, give neighboring shots the same brightness and the same target temperature. One warmer shot between two cool ones jumps out and breaks the scene.
O look de película tem pretos levemente: The film look has slightly lifted blacks (they don't reach zero) and whites that don't blow out. Aggressive S-curve contrast is one of the telltale marks of raw AI imagery.
Sombras, tons médios (onde está a pele): Shadows, midtones (where the skin is) and highlights each get their own tone. Keep saturation restrained: when in doubt, lower it. Skin stays neutral.
Grão, halation e proporção de tela entra: Grain, halation and aspect ratio come in at the end. Use grain with film's uneven texture, at the same intensity in every shot; halation (the reddish glow around a strong light) only when there is a light source in the frame.
Guarde o look num arquivo de cor (LUT, e: Save the look in a color file (LUT, .cube extension) or in an editor preset, and apply the same one to every shot.
Como dar o look, passo a passo: How to give the look, step by step

No prompt, peça luz e paleta da cena (cu: In the prompt, ask for the scene's light and palette (course 0, lesson 4), not the finishing. A neutral image, with neutral skin and shadows that keep detail, accepts any look later.
A imagem crua de IA costuma vir com cont: Raw AI imagery tends to arrive with aggressive contrast, strong red and orange color and pure black. Those three points are what color correction tackles first.
Escolha o plano mais bonito como referên: Pick the best-looking shot as your reference and match the others to it: brightness, temperature and contrast. Always compare with the neighboring shot, not the shot on its own.
Na fornada, a rua é fria e a padaria é n: In the first batch, the street is cold and the bakery is neutral. The change happens in a single cut, on purpose, not gradually shot by shot.

Combinações que brigam, como pastel com: Clashing combinations, like pastel with neon, break the film. Write the palette in one line and hold every shot to the same one.

Cinco perguntas sobre o curso inteiro. A: Five questions about the whole course. The explanation shows up after each answer.
Em que ordem fechar o filme na montagem?: In what order do you finish the film in the edit?
Cor, depois corte, depois legenda, depoi: Color, then cut, then subtitles, then the score last.
Corte, depois trilha e mixagem, depois c: Cut, then score and mix, then color, and subtitles and label last.
Legenda primeiro, para guiar os cortes p: Subtitles first, to guide the cuts by the text, and then color, sound and label.
Rótulo primeiro, e o resto em qualquer o: Label first, and the rest in any order.
Cor e legenda dependem do corte final; m: Color and subtitles depend on the final cut; working on them earlier means redoing the work. The label goes in at the end, over the finished film.
A página respondeu \"O vídeo tem 24,0 s;: The page answered "The video is 24.0 s long; the request is 30 to 60 s". What should you do?
Acelerar o vídeo até ele parecer mais lo: Speed up the video until it seems longer.
Exportar de novo em outro codec, sem mud: Export again in another codec, without changing the edit.
Trocar o formato para 9:16, porque o for: Switch the format to 9:16, because the vertical format accepts videos shorter than 30 s.
Voltar ao plano de edição e ajustar as b: Go back to the edit plan and adjust the beats until the total comes to 30 to 60 s.
A duração vem do plano: a lista se ajust: The length comes from the plan: the list adjusts to the length of the film. Codec and format don't change the length of the file.
Qual decisão sai junto com o vídeo gerad: Which decision comes out with the generated video, and which goes into the edit?
Ambiente e efeito saem junto; trilha e n: Ambience and effect come out together; score and long narration go into the edit.
Tudo sai junto: em 2026 a montagem não m: Everything comes out together: in 2026 the edit no longer touches the sound, which already arrives finished from the generator.
Nada sai junto: o som gerado deve sempre: Nothing comes out together: the generated sound should always be deleted.
Só a trilha sai junto; o resto é gravado: Only the score comes out together; the rest is recorded separately.
O que nasce da ação do plano sai bem com: What is born from the action in the shot comes out fine as native sound; what crosses shots goes on top, in the edit (lesson 2).
Para que serve o caminho da aula 5 (foto: What is the path in lesson 5 (photos and narration) for?
Só para quem não tem nenhuma foto e prec: Only for people who have no photos at all and need to generate all of them.
Para substituir o rótulo de IA, já que f: To replace the AI label, since photos are real.
Para fazer um filme sem gerador de vídeo: To make a film without a video generator and without spending credits.
Para aumentar a resolução dos clipes ger: To increase the resolution of the generated clips.
Fotos e narração com movimento de câmera: Photos and narration with camera movement become a film on any machine. If the images are generated, the label still applies.
Por que a pasta do projeto fica fora da: Why does the project folder stay outside the generation platform?
Porque as plataformas de geração apagam: Because generation platforms delete all of the user's files after one day of use.
Porque ferramenta muda ou fecha; com o p: Because tools change or shut down; with the plan and the prompts you can remake the film.
Porque a lei proíbe guardar arquivos na: Because the law forbids keeping files in the cloud.
Porque o conferidor só lê arquivos de pa: Because the checker only reads files from local folders.
O caso Sora (app fechado em 26/04/2026): The Sora case (app shut down on 04/26/2026) shows that tools disappear. What is yours (decisions and files) stays in your folder.
